universal_pipes.configuration.entity_tar: Allow pipes to use entities that expose item, fluid or energy capabilities as targets.

universal_pipes.configuration.tier_featu: Require the minimum tiers from the feature table in the datapack.
universal_pipes.configuration.network_up: Maximum pipes changed by one sneak-use of a Pipe Upgrade.
universal_pipes.configuration.allow_brid: Allow pipes of the bridging tier to join across a short air gap.
universal_pipes.configuration.allow_mate: Allow blocks from the materials tag to restyle pipes.
universal_pipes.configuration.material_b: Block ids that may never be used as a pipe material, on top of the datapack tag.
universal_pipes.configuration.dye_channe: Pipes of different dye colours do not connect, so parallel lines can touch.

universal_pipes.configuration.title: Universal Pipes Configuration
jei.universal_pipes.info.pipe: Connects to any block that exposes an item, fluid or energy capability. Use a Pipe Wrench on a connected face to cycle it between connected, disconnected and extract. Right click a pipe with an empty hand to open its screen.
jei.universal_pipes.info.wrench: Click a pipe face to cycle connection modes. Sneak and click an extract face to copy its settings. Sneak and click anything else to dismantle the pipe. Any item in the c:tools/wrench tag works too.
jei.universal_pipes.info.upgrade: Right click a pipe to raise its tier by one. Sneak while clicking to upgrade the connected line, up to the configured limit. Higher tiers move more per operation and unlock more filter slots, rules and bridging.
universal_pipes.configuration.give_guide: Give every player one Pipes Guide book the first time they join a world.
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.intro: Turn the page to see every recipe. Hover an item for its name. Any iron, copper, gold or netherite ingot works for its slot.
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.pipe.name: Pipe
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.pipe: Eight iron ingots in two rows with a gap between them make eight pipes.
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.wrench: Click a pipe face to cycle connected, disconnected, extract.
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.upgrade: Right click a pipe to raise it to tier %s. Sneak to upgrade the whole line.
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.guide.name: Guide Book
guide.universal_pipes.recipes.guide: A book and an iron ingot. You can always craft another.
guide.universal_pipes.intro.1: Universal Pipes is a single pipe that moves items, fluids and energy. There is one block to place, and every setting lives in its screen.
guide.universal_pipes.intro.2: Craft the Pipe from two rows of iron ingots, and the Pipe Wrench from iron ingots as well. Pipe Upgrades raise the tier of a pipe.
guide.universal_pipes.intro.3: Right click a pipe with an empty hand to open its screen. Sneak and right click with an empty hand to see how large its line is and what state it is in.
guide.universal_pipes.placing.1: Pipes join each other when placed side by side. A pipe also joins any adjacent block that accepts items, fluids or energy, but only moves things out of it once that face is set to extract.
guide.universal_pipes.placing.2: Pipes of the same line move things between the extract faces and every other block that can take them. Passive pipes use no processing, so long lines are cheap.
guide.universal_pipes.placing.3: A tier 4 pipe can join another pipe across a short air gap, if the config allows bridging.
guide.universal_pipes.wrench.1: Click a face with the wrench to cycle it: connected, disconnected, extract, connected again.
guide.universal_pipes.wrench.2: Sneak and click an extract face to copy its settings. The next extract face made with that wrench starts from the copy.
guide.universal_pipes.wrench.3: Sneak and click any other face to dismantle the pipe. The pipe keeps its settings and upgrade in the dropped item.
guide.universal_pipes.endpoints.1: Every extract face is an endpoint with its own settings. Pick a face in the pipe screen, then use the Items, Fluids or Energy tab.
guide.universal_pipes.endpoints.2: You can enable or disable it, require a redstone signal or its absence, and choose how targets are picked: round robin, nearest, furthest, random or priority.
guide.universal_pipes.endpoints.3: Keep in source leaves an amount behind in the source. Stop at target halts insertion at an amount. For energy both are a percentage.
guide.universal_pipes.tiers.1: A pipe has five tiers. A higher tier moves more per operation, runs more often and allows more filter slots and rules.
guide.universal_pipes.tiers.2: Right click a pipe with a Pipe Upgrade to raise it one tier. Sneak and click to upgrade the whole connected line, up to the configured limit.
guide.universal_pipes.tiers.name: Tier %s
guide.universal_pipes.tiers.fluids: Fluids: %1$s mB per operation, %2$s mB per second.
guide.universal_pipes.filters.1: The Filters view has a simple mode with filter slots and a whitelist or blacklist, and an advanced mode with an ordered list of rules.
guide.universal_pipes.filters.2: A rule allows or denies matching units. It can be limited to chosen targets and can cap the amount per operation.
guide.universal_pipes.filters.3: Expressions: an id, #tag, @namespace, ~part of a name, ?enchanted, ?damaged. Combine them with & | ! and brackets.
guide.universal_pipes.appearance.1: Use a dye to tint a pipe, a glow ink sac to make it luminous, or sneak with a block to give it that material. A water bucket clears the style.
guide.universal_pipes.appearance.2: One click styles the whole connected line, up to the configured limit.
guide.universal_pipes.appearance.3: With dye channels enabled, pipes of different colours do not join, so parallel lines can touch. Crosses channels in the pipe screen lets a pipe join other colours again.
guide.universal_pipes.commands.1: /upipes stats shows endpoints and cost per tick. /upipes profile shows the slowest faces. /upipes rebuild forces network discovery again.
guide.universal_pipes.commands.2: Limits and rules are in the mod configuration. Per tier values and the feature table are datapack files under universal_pipes/universal_pipes.
